screens.notes: Own top-level custom element (app-teacher-settings-view), not nested inside anything — CLAUDE.md's 'no nested Shadow DOM' rule. Reached from Dashboard's settings-menu, which today is a disabled placeholder — making it link here is a small reopen of the Dashboard view, same pattern as Login's session-gap reopen. The two nav-link elements are shared with academic-year-settings-screen: same elementIds, same rendered markup, produced by one plain shared function (e.g. settingsNav()), never a nested custom element — see CLAUDE.md's explicit allowance for sharing behavior via plain functions/an abstract base class.

screens.notes: Own top-level custom element (app-academic-year-settings-view), sibling to app-teacher-settings-view, not nested inside it or vice versa. `ciclos`/`modulos`/`anos_academicos`/the join table don't exist yet — this view's requirement-architect pass adds them. Follows lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md throughout: every table is inline-edit (the one exception, module-edit-confirm-modal, is a save-time confirmation gate, not an edit-interaction modal), dependency-blocked deletion decided server-side, and per-row data-element-id is derived at runtime as `<table-elementId>-row-<id>` rather than being a separate top-level elementId — that's why there's one elementId per table, not one per action button.

components.note: This is the one exception to lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md's 'never a modal' rule — that rule is about the EDIT interaction itself (still inline, in-row, here), not about a save-time confirmation gate. Editing a non-referenced módulo saves immediately with no modal. This modal renders inside app-academic-year-settings-view's own Shadow DOM (a conditionally-rendered lit-html block, like login-error-message), never a separate nested custom element.
